verdict.rationale: React documents React Native (native mobile), React DOM Server (streaming HTML), and explicitly supports 'as little or as much React as you need,' showing the component model targets multiple renderer backends via react-reconciler-based custom renderers. However, evidence never explicitly documents the public custom-renderer/react-reconciler API for building novel host targets (e.g., react-three-fiber, react-pdf) as a first-party documented capability — it's inferred from existing official renderers only. missing for 10: explicit docs on the react-reconciler package/custom renderer API, first-party guidance for writing a new renderer for an arbitrary platform, and independent hands-on confirmation of building a custom renderer.
